title: The Last Wolf
author: Rosalind Reyes
blurb: Hazel Dunmore, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
